summary: Dispute over withdrawal of e-auction sale; Liquidator's power to cancel auction pre-completion; Section 60 vs 61 appeal jurisdiction; reserve price adherence as ground for cancellation; balance payment timing under Liquidation Process Regulations 2016; auction terms acceptance binding; sole bidder status; promoter connections scrutiny; appeal allowed setting aside NCLAT order restoring liquidation process integrity.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 s.60, s.61, s.62
Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (Liquidation Process) Regulations, 2016 Clause 12, Clause 13
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; NCLAT order set aside; Liquidator directed to cancel auction sale; fresh e-auction permitted.
